title: Victor Lagno arXiv paper backs Pais room-temperature superconductor

tellings.quote: he showed that my room temperature superc conductor from a mechanism point of view could work and yet the the patent examiner just refused to grant the patent.

plain: A scientist named Victor Lagno, from the Russian Academy of Sciences, posted a paper on arXiv, a public website where scientists share research, showing that the room-temperature superconductor Salvatore Pais designed could work in principle. A superconductor carries electricity with no loss, and normally only works when deeply cooled. Pais, a Navy scientist known for unusual patents, says this himself and complains that the patent examiner still refused to grant his patent.
